incidents.description: The Python environment on the /workspace FUSE filesystem blocked during startup before any journal row existed. The process was terminated and the exact frozen CORE_QWEN environment was reconstructed on local container disk.
incidents.resolution: Rebuilt Python 3.11.16 with torch 2.4.1+cu124, transformers 4.57.1, accelerate 1.14.0, and huggingface-hub 0.36.0; CORE_QWEN preflight passed.

incidents.description: The resumed runner loaded from the FUSE Hugging Face cache and produced three rows before another FUSE read stall was diagnosed. The process was terminated only after the three append-and-fsync journal rows were observed operationally.
incidents.resolution: Copied the byte-identical 34,253,075,304-byte cache to local container disk, exposed it at the canonical /workspace/hf-cache path, reran CORE_QWEN preflight, and resumed from immutable logical keys without regenerating the three rows.
